footnote_text: Represents securities received as part of the Issuer's business combination, in connection with the Agreement and Plan of Merger and Reorganization, dated as of June 24, 2026 (as amended, modified, supplemented or waived from time to time, the "Merger Agreement"), by and among the Issuer (formerly known as Churchill Capital Corp XI), BLB Merger Sub, Inc. and Agility Robotics, Inc. ("Legacy Agility"), pursuant to which the common stock of Legacy Agility automatically converted into newly issued shares of Common Stock of the Issuer, pursuant to the terms of the Merger Agreement. In addition, each Legacy Agility stock option was automatically converted into the right to receive stock options of the Issuer, pursuant to the terms of the Merger Agreement.
